$comment: Controls budget (plans/site-v2.md, slice 3b): every interactive element on each built page and its job. Keyed by route pattern (srcRoute in .next/prerender-manifest.json). 'layout' entries apply to every page rendered inside the root layout; a route with "layout": false renders its own document. Entry: {kind, href or name, count (default 1, or "many"), job}. Kinds: link, button, input, select, textarea, summary, iframe, role-button, focusable, plus the classes "prose links" (any link inside .prose) and "scroll regions" (tabindex=0 on a scrolling pre, table or region). Checked by npm run lint:slop -- --built. dialogs lists controls that exist only in the browser after a visitor opens something (the invaders game): never in built HTML, so lint:slop -- --built does not see them; npm run check:pages opens the game on / and checks the rendered dialog against the layout, the route and these entries. Each page links a place once and a label names one place (rules duplicate-href and duplicate-label, owner review 4 Oct 2026), so no href repeats across the layout and a route.

layout.job: skip past the navigation to the page content (keyboard and screen reader users)
go to the home page (the name in the nav)
open the list of posts (in the nav only once a post is published; until then nothing links to /writing)

layout.name: Play space invaders
layout.job: start the hidden invaders game (the pixel alien in the header nav, next to About)

controls.job: see his LinkedIn profile from the hero (new tab); the one LinkedIn link on the page
see his code on GitHub from the hero (new tab); the one GitHub link on the page
read the ForestVO paper (new tab) from its row in Education and research
open a post (none while every post is a draft: the page then says only "Articles coming soon.")
follow new posts by RSS (a quiet link under the list, shown only once a post is published; the head's link rel=alternate appears at the same time)
follow a source or page the post cites
scroll a wide code block or table by keyboard
follow the paper, GitHub and LinkedIn links in the About text
reload the site from the home page after an error

invaders.name: Pause
invaders.job: pause a running game and see the unlocked links (a phone has no P or Escape key)

invaders.name: Quit
invaders.job: close the game and put the page back as it was, focus on the alien

invaders.name: Resume
invaders.job: carry on playing from the pause screen, including the screen a mystery-ship hit pauses on

invaders.name: Play again
invaders.job: start a new game after game over

invaders.name: Play anyway
invaders.job: play when the device asks for reduced motion (the game opens on a still frame)
open the ForestVO paper (new tab): the focused "Open ForestVO paper" link a hit pauses on, or its entry in the unlocked list on the pause or game-over screen; once per screen
open GitHub (new tab): the focused "Open GitHub" link a hit pauses on, or its entry in the unlocked list on the pause or game-over screen; once per screen
open LinkedIn (new tab): the focused "Open LinkedIn" link a hit pauses on, or its entry in the unlocked list on the pause or game-over screen; once per screen
